parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry `is_test: true` and reside in `Shared/AppServices/Tests/AppServicesTests/ReviewRequestServiceTests.swift`. The restraint rule mandates no-action whenever any participating record is a test fixture. Although the two methods — `recordPlaybackStartedIncrementsCount` (line 22) and `recordRequestSentIncrementsCount` (line 38) — share a Jaccard similarity of 0.75 and may well be candidates for a shared generic helper, extracting test-internal logic into shared production or shared-test infrastructure risks coupling test semantics to non-test targets. The structural similarity here is characteristic of parallel test cases that verify analogous counter-increment behaviours for distinct events, which is intentional test design rather than accidental duplication.
